note: Every ElevenLabs generation, approved or not. Account: free tier (non-commercial use, credit ElevenLabs). check_subscription's character_count lags and under-reported (300 shown for 12 clips); the user's dashboard showed 600, so a 5 s sound effect costs about 50 credits. Confirm every take's cost on the dashboard before the next spend. 2026-10-23: the animal run first logged lagged counter jumps on top of estimates (3,993 credits for 172 takes while the counter showed about 2,070); those takes were corrected to the 10-credits-a-second estimate, and sfxgen now charges only what the counter shows beyond the run's ledger.
